column3: “an offering” renders “qorban,” a thing brought near (throughout the chapter); “any man” renders “a man (adam).”
“that he may be accepted” renders “for his acceptance.”
“slay” renders “slaughter (shahat)” (also in verse 11), and “the young bull” renders “the son of the herd.”
“an offering by fire” renders “isheh,” and “a soothing aroma” renders “an odor of soothing” (also in verses 13 and 17).
“its crop” renders “its craw,” and “the ashes” renders “the fatty ashes.”
